# `sha`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a sha1 hash value as a hex string of the `expr`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
sha(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- sha, example 1
> SELECT sha('Spark');
85f5955f4b27a9a4c2aab6ffe5d7189fc298b92c
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
